title: 12 saal tak hile bina kyun khada raha Bahubali?
hooks: 12 saal tak hile bina kyun khada raha Bahubali?
Bel pairon pe chadhi, par woh nahi hile - kyun?
Rajya chhoda, fir bhi ek ahankaar bacha reh gaya?
hook_why: Direct visual question about the most striking image - 12 years motionless with vines - creates immediate curiosity without setup.
metaphor: Elephant of pride - the subtle ego that remains even after renouncing kingdom, which the sisters pointed out as the final barrier.

caption:
12 saal tak ek hi mudra mein khade rahe Bahubali. Par sabse bada bandhan bel nahi, ahankaar tha. 🐘➡️🧘‍♂️

Asli tyag rajya chhodne mein nahi, apne andar ke 'haathi' se utarne mein hai.

Aapke jeevan ka kaunsa 'haathi' abhi bhi bacha hai?

claims.claim: Bahubali meditated motionless in kayotsarga for 12 years with vines growing around his legs
Bahubali was son of Rishabhanatha (first Tirthankara) and brother of Bharata
Three contests held: eye-fight, water-fight, wrestling - Bahubali won all
Bharata used chakra-ratna which circled Bahubali harmlessly
Sisters (Brahmi and Sundari, who became nuns) told him to surrender ego - 'get down from elephant of pride'
claims.basis: Adipurana, Namo Buddy retelling, Jain tradition

claims.claim: Bahubali attained kevala jnana after renouncing subtle pride
Gommateshwara statue at Shravanabelagola is 57 feet tall depicting this meditation
